summary: Atlantic is a Berlin venture firm, founded in 2016, that says it has backed more than 200 European teams as their first-round lead investor. Its Approach page describes a generalist mandate focused on leading pre-seed rounds for Europe's most ambitious founders, with four themes where it is particularly active: AI and compute, energy and climate, industrial and robotics, and space and security. Check size is not stated. The imprint publishes the Berlin office address of the management company.
